method: Original procedural geometry based on the existing metric route and estimated building layout; nearby reference photographs inform construction details only.
accuracy: Not photogrammetry or a surveyed reconstruction. No claim that the shop names, windows, facade colors, air conditioners, drain placement, alley background buildings, or inferred 32–76 metre alley continuation match the real addresses.

scope.batching: Geometry combined by material; nine small TextMesh shop labels remain separate.
scope.undo: Apply replaces the named detail root and hides the nine source facade objects. Remove restores those source facade objects. Generated assets are retained for deterministic reuse.

visual_features: Metric arcade pillars, stone plinths, grouted paving and recessed shop fronts
Metal rolling shutters, aluminium door frames, modest fictional shop fascias
Pitched canopies, exposed support frames, gutters, rainwater pipes and utility meters
Varied windows with curtains, sparse security grilles and service equipment
Windows and floor bands on both alley-facing corner return walls
Curb wear, surface gutters and slotted drain covers
Non-playable background alley continuation that screens the finite map edge

reference_photographs.author: Kiyoteru Awaji
reference_photographs.observed: Surface-mounted pipes and wires, awning steelwork, security grilles, utility meters, concrete wear and drain grates. Nearby lane rather than exact modeled corner.

reference_photographs.author: Solomon203
reference_photographs.observed: Tingzhou Road ground-floor shop framing, recessed entries, wall meters and material scale behind the vehicle.

photograph_use: Reference only. No photograph pixels are embedded in meshes, textures or the game build.
textures: Reuses the project's existing concrete_wall_003, concrete_tile_facade, concrete_floor_worn_001 and asphalt_02 maps. Existing Sources/asset-manifest.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt retain their provenance.
